window.rationale: Final 7 days of Windows-era operation. Apr 12 chosen as start: event volume jumped from 1,603 (Apr 11) to 45,925 (Apr 12) following v0.29.3-v0.29.5 observability improvements, making it the first representative day. This window covers 400,201 of 416,595 total Windows-era events (96%).
